properties.description: The served half of dec:idea-a-refused-typed-write-stores-nothing. call_tool opens a CallUnit for a write tool; SharedGraph::hold_for_write (visible to service.rs alone) takes the graph's write lock at the call's first write and opens the store's batch; SharedGraph::read serves reads inside the call from that hold; CallUnit::settle commits or discards once. An unsettled hold discards on drop.
properties.name: service/unit.rs — one write unit per served tool call: CallUnit, CallScope and SharedGraph, the only doors to the design
